MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

7. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

8. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

9. Solve for x: x + 3 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 10
   C. 8
   D. 3

10. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

13. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 3
   C. 13
   D. 40

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

15. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 56

16. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
